raw_text: PATTERN ALERT: Chinese cognitive warfare campaign detected targeting India on Doklam. Assessment: Centrally directed narrative operation, likely PLA Strategic Support Force information warfare unit. Purpose: establish pretext narrative before upcoming diplomatic engagement.
